sources.title: W3C WAI: Labeling controls
sources.requirement: Use an associated label for each form control; aria-label is an alternative, not an additional requirement when a label exists.

sources.title: MDN: Email input
sources.requirement: Use input type=email and browser constraint validation as the frontend email syntax baseline; it does not verify mailbox ownership.

sources.title: MDN: HTML forms
sources.requirement: Use semantic form controls and labels; separate presentation and behavior into linked CSS and JavaScript files.
